title: Day 9,002 of America's Longest War — Op Ghazab Day 95; 26-Day Strike Pause; Eid al-Adha & TTP Ceasefire Imminent; Jawid Niazi Day 25 in Taliban GDI Custody
detail:
May 31, 2026 (Day 9,002 of the war since Operation Enduring Freedom launched October 7, 2001; Day 95 of Operation Ghazab lil-Haq): No confirmed Pakistani cross-border airstrikes into Afghanistan for a 26th consecutive day since the May 5 Dangam (Kunar) strike. Eid al-Adha 2026 is now imminent, bringing the TTP's announced 3-day ceasefire (10th–12th Dhu al-Hijjah) into effect.

EID AL-ADHA AND TTP CEASEFIRE: With Eid al-Adha 2026 approaching (the Islamic lunar calendar positions Eid al-Adha's first day around June 6-7, 2026 pending moon sighting), TTP leader Noor Wali Mehsud's announced 3-day ceasefire covering the 10th–12th of Dhu al-Hijjah is now approaching activation. The TTP's Eid ceasefire practice — consistently observed for both Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha — provides a brief operational pause in TTP attacks within Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KPK) province. The ceasefire does not affect the bilateral Af-Pak state confrontation (which involves the Afghan Taliban IEA, not TTP directly), but Pakistani security analysts view it as a signal that TTP is calibrating its operations to the Urumqi-process non-escalation framework. Pakistan's Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) has not commented on the upcoming Eid pause.

JAWID NIAZI — DAY 25: Paigard News Agency director Jawid (Ahmad Jawed) Niazi entered his 25th consecutive day in Taliban General Directorate of Intelligence (GDI) custody on May 31, 2026 — arrested on May 6 alongside TOLOnews journalists Mansoor Niazi (released May 27 on bail, Day 20) and Imran Danish (released May 27 on bail, Day 18). Unlike the TOLOnews journalists, Jawid Niazi has received: no bail, no publicly announced charges, no confirmed legal access to counsel. His extended incommunicado detention in GDI facilities — the Taliban's primary political security organ — signals the Islamic Emirate treats his case as a political-intelligence matter rather than a media regulation issue. The CPJ, Amnesty International, UNAMA, and RSF (Reporters Without Borders) continue to specifically call for his unconditional release. Trial for the TOLOnews journalists is expected after Eid al-Adha.

DIPLOMATIC STATUS: No Urumqi Round 2 date announced. China has not publicly engaged on Af-Pak mediation since April 8. Russia's newly signed Military-Technical Cooperation Agreement with the Taliban (May 27-28) — the first formal bilateral defense pact between any country and Taliban-ruled Afghanistan — remains the defining diplomatic development of the past week. Pakistan's three core demands — Taliban formally designates TTP as a terrorist organization, dismantles TTP infrastructure, provides verifiable proof — remain unmet after 95 days of Operation Ghazab lil-Haq.

HUMANITARIAN SITUATION: WFP continues to urgently require $313 million to address malnutrition affecting 4.9 million Afghan mothers and children in 2026. The UN humanitarian appeal for Afghanistan remains approximately 60% unfunded. Displacement from the 2026 Af-Pak conflict stands at 189,000+ internally displaced persons, with 146,000+ Afghans deported from Pakistan in 2026 and additional returns from Iran. The Taliban's Decree No. 18 (May 14) — treating a woman's silence as consent to marriage — remains in force despite sustained international condemnation from UNAMA, UN Special Rapporteur Richard Bennett, and women's rights organizations.

WAR MILESTONE CONTEXT: May 31, 2026 — Day 9,002 — is the 9,002nd day since the United States launched Operation Enduring Freedom on October 7, 2001, making it America's longest-ever foreign war. The US spent $2.3 trillion, trained an Afghan National Army that collapsed in 11 days in August 2021, and now watches from the sidelines as Russia formalizes military ties with the Taliban government that America spent two decades fighting. No US diplomatic engagement in the current Af-Pak crisis has been publicly announced.

media.caption: Khaama Press: TTP leader Noor Wali Mehsud's 3-day Eid al-Adha ceasefire is imminent as Eid approaches in early June 2026 — Day 9,002 of America's Afghanistan war.
CPJ documents Jawid Niazi (Paigard News Agency) — Day 25 in Taliban GDI custody with no bail, no charges, no legal access as of May 31, 2026.
